plan.design: Two-round closed loop. Round 1 (n=15 oracle queries): stratified sample across model rank positions (top-20 densely + spread across the full distribution) to estimate the model-vs-measured relationship (Spearman rho, affine calibration, residual SD) and the population 75th-percentile GRWT100 threshold. Revise ranking. Round 2 (n<=15): query the highest-value unqueried candidates and near-miss alternatives to refine the top-10. Final 10 chosen by max posterior P(GRWT100 in top quartile).
controls: Same trait GRWT100, same genotype-derived model (ridge on pruned SNPs), same candidate pool of 904 IRIS_313 lines
all comparisons use the same oracle measurement definition. Stratify sampling by model rank position to avoid confounding with rank.
plan.observation_metric: Spearman rank correlation between model prediction and oracle measurement on queried lines (>0.3 deemed useful); precision@10 = fraction of final-10 whose measured GRWT100 exceeds the estimated population 75th percentile.
plan.refutation_condition: If Spearman rho <= 0.1 on >=12 queried lines (no rank signal), or if precision@10 <= 0.5, the hypothesis that model-guided selection enriches the high-grain-weight quartile is refuted.

revision: ACCEPTED: model-guided (rice_gs, GRWT100) two-round closed loop enriches the high-grain-weight quartile with high confidence; final top-10 chosen by measured value with model-prediction tie-break.
reason: Observed Spearman 0.944 >> 0.1 refutation threshold; calibration r2=0.743; all 10 final lines measured >=3.4 g, above the bootstrap CI upper bound (2.85) of the pool quartile threshold, so the enrichment hypothesis is strongly supported and the selection stands.
